article_title: Comedian Paul Whitehouse mugged at London cashpoint

tasks.prompt: What is the main event reported in the article?
options: Paul Whitehouse fought back when someone tried to steal his card at a London cash machine.
Paul Whitehouse lost a fishing competition with Bob Mortimer.
A Harry Potter television set was robbed in London.
Dawn French had a bad reaction to medication.
tasks.correct_answer: Paul Whitehouse fought back when someone tried to steal his card at a London cash machine.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: האירוע המרכזי הוא הניסיון לגנוב את כרטיסו של פול וייטהאוס בכספומט והמאבק שלו בתוקף.

tasks.prompt: Why had Whitehouse gone out on Friday?
options: To record an episode of Gone Fishing
To collect medication for his wife
To meet Dawn French in Islington
To rehearse for the Harry Potter series
tasks.correct_answer: To collect medication for his wife
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי אשתו, הוא יצא להביא עבורה תרופה לאחר תגובה רעה לטיפול.

tasks.prompt: In the report, what does “retrieved his card” mean?
options: He cancelled the card online.
He gave the card to the police.
He got the card back.
He used the card to buy medicine.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: retrieved פירושו השיב לעצמו או קיבל בחזרה; וייטהאוס הצליח לקחת בחזרה את כרטיסו.

tasks.prompt: What does “the perp scuttling away empty-handed” mean in context?
options: The attacker waited beside the cash machine.
The attacker called for medical help.
The attacker returned the stolen money later.
The attacker hurried away without taking anything.
tasks.correct_answer: The attacker hurried away without taking anything.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: scuttling away מתאר בריחה מהירה, ו־empty-handed אומר שהתוקף לא הצליח לקחת דבר.

tasks.prompt: Why did Mine Conkbayir make the Instagram post?
options: To advertise Whitehouse's upcoming television role
To warn other people to stay alert around cash machines
To announce a new series of Gone Fishing
To ask fans to nominate Whitehouse for a Bafta
tasks.correct_answer: To warn other people to stay alert around cash machines
tasks.explanation_hebrew: היא הסבירה שפרסמה בתקווה לעזור לאחרים להיות מודעים וזהירים כשהם בחוץ.

tasks.prompt: Which statement about Whitehouse's television work is correct?
options: He has presented Gone Fishing since 2008.
Gone Fishing has never received a Bafta nomination.
He has been cast as Argus Filch in an upcoming Harry Potter series.
He plays Bob Mortimer in The Fast Show.
tasks.correct_answer: He has been cast as Argus Filch in an upcoming Harry Potter series.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת שהוא לוהק לתפקיד אב הבית ארגוס פילץ' בסדרת הארי פוטר העתידית של HBO.

tasks.prompt: Describe what Conkbayir said happened at the cash machine.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין ניסיון גניבת הכרטיס, המאבק של וייטהאוס, השבת הכרטיס ובריחת התוקף בלי שלל.
expected_points: Someone tried to steal Whitehouse's card at a cash machine behind a Sainsbury's in Islington.
Whitehouse fought back and recovered the card.
The attacker fled without taking anything.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the incident and the public response in three or four sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לסכם את הסיבה ליציאה, ניסיון השוד, האזהרה לציבור והתגובות התומכות של חברים ומעריצים.
expected_points: Whitehouse went out to collect medication for his wife and was attacked at a cash machine.
He fought back, recovered his card and the attacker escaped empty-handed.
Conkbayir urged people to be vigilant and aware.
Friends and fans condemned the attack and wished him a speedy recovery.

tasks.prompt: What do the quoted reactions from Dawn French and Angela Barnes add to the report?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שהציטוטים מדגימים גינוי ציבורי ותמיכה אישית בזוג, ומחזקים את תיאור האירוע כחמור ולא מקובל.
expected_points: They show that fellow comedians publicly condemned the attack.
They express sympathy and support for Whitehouse and Conkbayir.
They reinforce the report's description of the incident as serious and unacceptable.

tasks.prompt: Write a short safety notice inspired by the report, using the words “vigilant”, “aware” and “incident”.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב הודעה עניינית שאינה מאשימה את הקורבן, משתמשת נכון בשלוש המילים ומציעה זהירות מעשית ליד כספומט.
expected_points: Use all three required words in context.
Advise people to pay attention to their surroundings at cash machines.
Avoid exaggerating beyond the facts of the reported incident.
